UI/UX case study

Opalite Fitness

Mobile appDark-mode UIWireframe to UI

Opalite Fitness is a gym-buddy fitness app. I took it from a low-fidelity wireframe to high-fidelity dark-mode screens covering the intro, home, membership plans and workout pages.

My role

UI/UX design: wireframing, visual design and screen flows, from the first grey-box layout to the final UI.

Screens

Key design decisions

  • Resume in one tap. The home screen leads with a “Continue workout” card showing today’s session, progress and a Continue button.
  • Stats at a glance. Calories, step count and step distance sit in three compact tiles right under the workout card.
  • Quick actions. A four-icon row (Workouts, Gym plans, Nutrition, Progress) plus a free-trial offer banner and “Book Free Trial” card.
  • Easy-to-compare plans. Annual, half-year and quarterly plans are stacked with a “Most popular” tag and the per-month price shown.
  • Focused workout page. A weekly split (Today, Push, Pull, Legs), a numbered exercise list and one clear Start Workout button.
  • Dark UI, teal accent. A dark theme with a teal highlight keeps the actions easy to spot.

UI/UX case study

NBC App Redesign

RedesignMobile appLoyalty & commerce

A redesign of the NBC café app’s home and order (menu) screens, focused on getting people to the menu faster while keeping the loyalty experience front and centre.

My role

UI/UX design: reviewing the existing screens and redesigning the home and menu pages.

Screens

Key design decisions

  • Menu first on home. The Explore Menu category grid (Cloud series, Cold Beverage, Food, Desserts, Hot Beverage, Combos and more) now opens the home screen.
  • Loyalty stays visible. The NBC Coins card and tier progress (Rookie, Litt, Icon, G.O.A.T.) remain right below the categories.
  • Clear ordering context. A greeting, the selected outlet and the Dine In / Self Pickup toggle sit at the top.
  • Favorites on the menu page. A compact grid of favorite items with prices replaces the single large “Order Again” card.
  • Quicker browsing. The coins card is slimmer, and Pure Veg and search stay one tap away.
  • Warm, clean look. A cream background with NBC blue accents.
